verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets a Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent that auto-remediates level 1 alerts, escalates high-risk or complex cases to humans, and lets users review or override any agent decision. That covers the in-product agent reviewing screening matches. Nothing shows the agent records a rationale for each decision; the case audit-trail endpoint logs case activity but is not described as capturing agent reasoning. Missing for 10: documented recording of agent rationale per match, in-depth first-party docs on how the agent decides (only marketing snippets), independent or hands-on corroboration.
